rca_of_issue.bug: Customer dropdown showing empty when opening New Approval dialog
rca_of_issue.root_cause: The Approvals.js file was using localStorage.getItem('token') but the auth system stores the token as 'auth_token'
reproduction_steps: 4. Click Customer dropdown - shows empty (before fix)
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Changed all 6 occurrences of localStorage.getItem('token') to localStorage.getItem('auth_token') in /app/frontend/src/pages/Approvals.js
rca_of_issue.verification: After fix, customer dropdown shows 4 customers and job dropdown populates correctly after customer selection
